system.name: Valinor-h
system.one_liner: an eBPF-based measurement framework with a kernel data plane and a userspace control plane communicating via lock-free ring buffers

components.name: Network Application
components.role: generates traffic that flows down the kernel stack

components.name: Network Socket
components.role: socket layer the application writes to

components.name: TCP/IP
components.role: transport/IP processing layer

components.name: Queuing disciplines
components.role: qdisc layer where the Valinor-H data-plane program attaches

components.name: Valinor-H Data-plane
components.role: eBPF program executed at the tc qdisc on every sk_buff to measure traffic

components.name: Netdev
components.role: network device layer below queuing disciplines

components.name: NIC
components.role: hardware that transmits packets to the network

components.name: Packets to the network
components.role: final output of the kernel-stack pipeline

components.name: Compiler, verifier and libbpf
components.role: loads and verifies the eBPF data-plane program into the kernel

components.name: Valinor-H Control-plane
components.role: userspace component that manages the data plane and consumes measurement data

components.name: Linux Virtual File System
components.role: exposes the per-CPU eBPF ring buffers to userspace

components.name: Per-CPU buffers
components.role: lock-free ring buffers carrying measurement records from the data plane

components.name: Shared control data
components.role: in-kernel state written by the data plane and read by the control plane

components.name: Write handle
components.role: handle the data plane uses to write into shared control data

components.name: Read handle
components.role: handle the control plane uses to read shared control data

components.name: Poller Threads
components.role: userspace threads polling the ring buffers for new records

components.name: Redis Backend
components.role: storage backend the poller threads write measurement results into

components.name: Flow filters
components.role: control-plane processing applied to polled records

components.name: Timestamper
components.role: control-plane processing applied to polled records

components.name: Stat Analytics
components.role: control-plane processing and analytics applied to polled records

content.key_idea: A kernel eBPF program hooked at the tc qdisc measures every sk_buff and hands records to a userspace control plane through lock-free per-CPU ring buffers for filtering, timestamping, and storage.
content.reading_order: Left column top-to-bottom follows the kernel stack from Network Application to the NIC; the right side shows the userspace control plane reading the data plane's output via Write/Read handles.

Figure 3 presents the design of our eBPF framework

summary: Figure 3 shows the architecture of Valinor-h, the paper's eBPF-based measurement framework, split into a kernel data plane and a userspace control plane. On the left, the ordinary Linux stack (Network Application, Network Socket, TCP/IP, Queuing disciplines, Netdev, NIC) carries an sk_buff down to the wire; the Valinor-H Data-plane is an eBPF program attached at the tc qdisc that inspects every sk_buff. On the right, a Compiler, verifier and libbpf toolchain loads this program and manages the Valinor-H Control-plane, which reads measurement records the data plane writes (Write handle) into per-CPU, lock-free ring buffers exposed through the Linux Virtual File System, via a Read handle. Poller Threads drain these buffers, apply flow filters, timestamping, and stat analytics, and push the resulting records into a Redis Backend for storage.
summary_zh: 图3展示Valinor-h架构：内核在tc qdisc挂载eBPF数据面处理每个sk_buff，通过Write/Read handle与用户态控制面共享无锁环形缓冲区；轮询线程读取后过滤、打时间戳、统计，写入Redis。
